name: wheelset flexibility
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轮对在动态作用下发生弹性变形的性质。

complete_examples.text: With this consid-eration, vehicle-track dynamic analysis considering wheelset flexibility has gradually attracted more and more attention for exploring wheel-rail high-frequency vibration (Kaiser et al., 2020; Koh and Park, 2011; Tao et al., 2020; Wu et al., 2015, 2017, 2018).

Han et al. (2017) established a vehicle-track coupled model considering the rotating flexible wheelset, the influence of the wheelset flexibility and rotation were analyzed in detail, and further explored the influence of wheelset flexibility on wheel-rail noise.
